definitions.gloss: frequent occurrence; multiple outbreaks; repeated incidents
definitions.explanation: The occurrence of something many times or in large numbers. Used especially for negative events like accidents, crimes, or disasters.

examples.japanese: {交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}が{多発|たはつ}している。
この{地域|ちいき}では{犯罪|はんざい}が{多発|たはつ}している。
examples.english: Crime is frequent in this area.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}シーズンには{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れが{多発|たはつ}するため、{早|はや}めの{避難|ひなん}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Landslides occur frequently during typhoon season, so early evacuation is important.

notes:
Describes the frequent or repeated occurrence of events, especially negative ones. Composed of {多|た} (many) + {発|はつ} (occurrence/outbreak). Commonly used as a する verb: {多発|たはつ}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}{多発|たはつ}: frequent accidents
- {事故|じこ}{多発|たはつ}{地帯|ちたい}: accident-prone zone
- {犯罪|はんざい}が{多発|たはつ}する: crime occurs frequently
- {多発|たはつ}する{地域|ちいき}: area with frequent occurrences
- {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}が{多発|たはつ}する: food poisoning breaks out frequently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頻発|ひんぱつ}: frequent occurrence — very close in meaning, slightly more formal
- {続出|ぞくしゅつ}: occurring one after another — emphasizes successive appearance
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}: frequently — an adjectival word describing general frequency

USAGE:
Almost always used for undesirable events. You would not typically use {多発|たはつ} for positive occurrences. The compound {事故|じこ}{多発|たはつ}{地帯|ちたい} (accident-prone zone) is commonly seen on road signs in Japan.

cross_references.label: occurring one after another, successive occurrence
